name: Eightsend (formerly CentralComs)
long_description:
Eightsend is an AI marketing team for DTC brands. 

Connect your store, ad accounts and analytics, and it finds who actually buys from you, builds a campaign plan, makes new ads every week, launches them on Meta, Google and TikTok, and moves budget to what's selling. 

Every test feeds next week's ads and budget, so results keep improving. It replaces the separate creative, ads and analytics agencies a brand would otherwise hire
one_liner: AI marketers that run paid ads for DTC brands so you can sell more…
